# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `glean` MCP server backed by Glean's hosted remote MCP server (`/mcp/default`).
- Declared the `GLEAN_INSTANCE` plugin variable so each organization points at its own Glean backend.
- Logo: Glean's mark from Glean's own plugin repository (MIT, see `LICENSE.glean-logo`).
